title: Why Referees Show Yellow and Red Cards
hook: Ever wondered why a referee lifts a bright card above his head instead of shouting? The story behind those cards is a blend of traffic lights, a World Cup clash, and a simple way to keep the game fair.

title: Why Test Cricket Is the Ultimate Marathon of Sport
hook: Imagine a game that can stretch over five days, demanding patience, strategy and stamina like a long road trip across the Karoo.

title: The day one rugby match helped unite a country
hook: On 24 June 1995, a drop goal in extra time won South Africa the Rugby World Cup. But what happened before kick-off mattered even more than the score.
